root_cause: The radios module only updates ARIA attributes and conditional visibility on click events, not on change events triggered by keyboard navigation, causing conditional panels to remain visible when a different radio is selected via arrow keys.
repair_strategy: Add a change event listener to the radios module that mirrors the click handler logic, invoking setAttributes on radios with aria-controls to ensure ARIA state and visibility are updated when the radio state changes via keyboard.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now navigate between radio options using arrow keys and see associated conditional content show/hide correctly, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Both click and change listeners may execute for mouse interactions, causing setAttributes to run twice (idempotent).
Minimal performance overhead from additional event listener.
No impact on non-radio elements as listener is scoped to the module.
verification_requirements: Verify that selecting a radio via arrow keys updates aria-expanded and toggles the correct conditional panel visibility.
Verify that mouse clicks continue to work as before.
Verify that choosing 'Text message' then arrowing to 'I do not want reminders' hides the mobile number field.
Verify that choosing 'Email' shows the email input field.
Ensure no regression in existing form submission or validation behavior.
